title: Blue Pearl | KEY.co
description_expanded: The home’s interior is a celebration of refined taste and thoughtful design. The ground level hosts two primary suites, each an enclave of luxury, with one boasting mesmerizing views of the resort-style pool through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows. The state-of-the-art kitchen, equipped with the finest appliances and a welcoming island, becomes the heart of the home, where culinary creativity meets moments of connection. Ascending the elegant staircase to the second floor reveals additional exquisite living spaces, including two more primary suites and a delightful bunk room, designed with the younger guests in mind. Outside, the private oasis, complete with a resort-style pool and meticulous landscaping, offers a sanctuary for relaxation and entertainment. This home not only provides access to the pristine beaches and vibrant culture of Grayton Beach but also stands as a beacon of luxury and tranquility in one of the most sought-after locations along the 30A corridor.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 6 - Second floor: Two Single Over Double Bunks
